slides.headline: Buying to rent it out? The rebate *works differently*.

slides.label: The rule
slides.headline: The owner-occupied rebates need someone to *live there*.
slides.body: Both require the home to be your or a relation's primary residence.

slides.label: At closing
slides.headline: is due if you rent it out.
slides.body: The builder won't take the rebate off the price, so your cash needed at closing goes up.

slides.label: Afterward
slides.headline: Claim the *rental rebate* yourself.
slides.body: The New Residential Rental Property rebate is filed with CRA after closing.

caption:

🏡 The owner-occupied rebates need you or a relation to live there
💵 Rent it out and you pay the full HST at closing
